dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the body mass from the mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor localized bulge on the left lateral margin corresponding to the position of the pectoral fin; otherwise, the margins are smooth and continuous.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white with subtle low-frequency grey-blue gradients in shadowed regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular aperture at the blowhole; prominent raised dorsal ridge along the posterior half of the visible axis casting a slight longitudinal shadow to the left.
